module counter_03 (
  input clk,
  input rst_n,
  input en,
  output [3:0] bcd_ones,
  output [3:0] bcd_tens,
  output carry_out
);

  reg [3:0] counter_ones;
  reg [3:0] counter_tens;
  reg carry_out_reg;

  assign bcd_ones = counter_ones;
  assign bcd_tens = counter_tens;
  assign carry_out = carry_out_reg;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      counter_ones <= 4'd0;
      counter_tens <= 4'd0;
      carry_out_reg <= 1'd0;
    end else if (en) begin
      if (counter_ones == 4'd9) begin
        counter_ones <= 4'd0;
        counter_tens <= (counter_tens == 4'd9) ? 4'd0 : counter_tens + 1;
        carry_out_reg <= (counter_tens == 4'd9) ? 1'd1 : 1'd0;
      end else begin
        counter_ones <= counter_ones + 1;
        carry_out_reg <= 1'd0;
      end
    end
  end

endmodule
